iteration_definition: One active scheduler S_WAIT arbitration decision; count no-flip and pipeline-empty decisions; exclude capture, memory-update and drain cycles. At most one accepted flip per iteration, with up to 25 local units proposing in parallel.
spinnaker_alignment: Native implementation-iteration comparison. S5.2 states a fixed iteration count but does not state its numeric count for Fig S3 or establish the same event definition; 100M is our explicitly chosen budget, motivated by the paper's main evaluation.
quality_rule: Independently score every final best assignment; retain every seed and rejected-decision count.
